About Serenade Strings – Wedding String Quartet in Cardiff, London & UK

Meet the musicians behind Serenade Strings—modern, professional, and passionate about making your wedding or event unforgettable.

Modern, Professional, and Personal Wedding Musicians

Our Story

Serenade Strings was founded by a group of friends and professional musicians who share a passion for making weddings and events unforgettable. Based in Cardiff and London, our string quartet performs across the UK—from intimate ceremonies in the Cotswolds to grand celebrations in central London and relaxed garden parties in South Wales.

What Makes Us Different

We’re more than just musicians—we’re a close-knit team who care about every detail of your day. Clients love our modern approach, huge repertoire (pop, rock, film, classical, and more), and willingness to arrange special requests. We’ve played at venues like Hensol Castle, The Old Naval College, and boutique hotels across Cardiff, London, and Bristol.

Tailored for Your Event

Every booking is personal. Whether you want Bridgerton-style ceremony music, a pop hit for your drinks reception, or a bespoke arrangement for your first dance, we’ll work with you to create the perfect soundtrack. We offer quartet, trio, and duo line-ups to suit every venue and budget, and we’re always happy to travel.

Trusted, Experienced, & Flexible

Our musicians are all graduates of top UK conservatoires and have performed at hundreds of weddings and events. We’re trusted by couples, venues, and planners for our professionalism, reliability, and friendly service. As part of the same family as Aderyn String Quartet, we bring a proven track record and a personal touch to every booking.

Weddings & Corporate Events

Most of our work is for weddings, but we also perform for corporate events, awards, and private parties. Whatever the occasion, we tailor our setlist and style to suit your needs—always bringing the same energy, polish, and attention to detail.

Get in Touch

Want to check availability or ask about a special request? Contact us today—we’d love to be part of your celebration.
